LifecycleStage.description:
Trend lifecycle phase inferred for this event (per §2.3 + §2.4).

Per §2.4 rule #2 (shadow isolation protocol): when the classifier for a
given lifecycle phase is in shadow, Signal Engine MUST emit Unknown
rather than fabricating True/False. The `ongoing` phase depends on the
persistent_momentum classifier which is shadow today (live_status=False
on its tags), so events whose phase identification would require ongoing
classification surface as Unknown until promotion.

Per §2.4 rule #4 the consuming Rule Engine MUST fail-loud on Unknown —
no silent coercion to a default; the conservative path (= ongoing
inactive) is taken explicitly.
LifecycleStage.title: LifecycleStage

SetupTag.description:
One element of an event's setup_composition.

`live_status=False` marks shadow components (per §2.4 Shadow Isolation
protocol). The downstream Decision Boundary in Rule Engine MUST filter
these out before sizing/structure decisions; only live tags participate
in compositional upgrades. Shadow tags are still recorded for forensic
review.
SetupTag.title: SetupTag

SetupType.description:
Lifecycle setup taxonomy (per docs/strategy_synthesis_design.md §3.1).

Four kinds split by trend lifecycle phase:
  - breakout         : birth phase. Trigger = squeeze release (Donchian
                       breakout TBD). Event-driven.
  - pullback_resume  : re-entry phase. Trigger = 1H SuperTrend flip with
                       higher-timeframe trend aligned with the new direction.
                       Event-driven.
  - reversal_start   : reversal phase. Trigger = 1H SuperTrend flip without
                       HTF alignment. Event-driven, lowest base rate.
  - persistent_momentum : ongoing phase. State-driven (cross-sectional RS
                          rank within sector + discrete-info filter + EMA
                          structural alignment). Forensic-only until promoted
                          from shadow.
SetupType.title: SetupType
